run_lfs_enable_largefiles: run lfs_enable_largefiles to configure a git repository for uploading files larger than 5GB using multipart transfer
run_lfs_multipart_upload: run lfs_multipart_upload as a git-lfs custom transfer agent to handle chunked uploads of large files to Hugging Face Hub
read_lfs_read_msg: read lfs_read_msg to parse line-delimited JSON messages from stdin for the git-lfs custom transfer protocol
write_lfs_write_msg: write lfs_write_msg to send line-delimited JSON progress and completion messages to stdout
review_lfs_multipart_upload: review lfs_multipart_upload to understand how it splits large files into chunks and uploads them via presigned URLs
